title: Ridgeline Door Options Price List (Entry & Patio Door Contracts)
content:
Option prices for Entry & Patio Door Contracts, by door series. The columns are the Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door, Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door, Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door, Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door, Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door and Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door, shown by their short series names.

| Option | Portal 310 | Portal 520 | Glide 720 | Portal 640 | Glide 840 | Hinge 960 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sidelite (each, where offered) | $612.00 | $784.00 | not offered ($0.00) | $892.00 | not offered ($0.00) | not offered ($0.00) |
| Transom above a unit (each, where offered) | $418.00 | $536.00 | not offered ($0.00) | $598.00 | not offered ($0.00) | $712.00 |
| Multipoint lock, per unit | $189.00 | $189.00 | standard ($0.00) | $214.00 | standard ($0.00) | standard ($0.00) |
| Factory smart lock preparation, per unit | $96.00 | $96.00 | $128.00 | $96.00 | $128.00 | $128.00 |
| Decorative or blinds-between-glass insert, per unit | $385.00 | $465.00 | $548.00 | $520.00 | $612.00 | $690.00 |
| Factory paint or stain finish upgrade, per unit | $165.00 | $245.00 | $210.00 | $365.00 | $290.00 | $410.00 |
| Matching storm door (each, where offered) | $489.00 | $489.00 | not offered ($0.00) | $489.00 | not offered ($0.00) | not offered ($0.00) |
| Low-profile accessible threshold, per unit | $148.00 | $148.00 | $186.00 | $148.00 | $186.00 | $212.00 |

## Availability by series

| Option | Offered in this series | Not offered |
|---|---|---|
| Sidelites | Portal 310, Portal 520, Portal 640 | Glide 720, Glide 840, Hinge 960 |
| Transom | Portal 310, Portal 520, Portal 640, Hinge 960 | Glide 720, Glide 840 |
| Matching storm door | Portal 310, Portal 520, Portal 640 | Glide 720, Glide 840, Hinge 960 |

A multipoint lock is already standard on the Glide 720, Glide 840, Hinge 960 series, where its price is $0.00; on the Portal 310, Portal 520, Portal 640 series it is an added option at the per-unit price shown. Where a sidelite, transom or storm door is not offered, the listed price is $0.00.

## Price meanings

- Sidelite: price per sidelite added where sidelites are available in the series.
- Transom: price per transom added above a unit where transoms are available.
- Multipoint lock: price per unit to add a multipoint lock where it is not standard.
- Smart lock preparation: price per unit for factory preparation for an electronic smart lock.
- Decorative glass: price per unit for a decorative or blinds-between-glass insert.
- Finish upgrade: price per unit for a factory paint or stain finish upgrade.
- Storm door: price per matching storm door added where available.
- Low-profile threshold: price per unit for a low-profile accessible threshold.

Hypothetical reading: a decorative glass insert on three Ridgeline Portal 640 units is listed at three times $520.00, that is $1560.00.
